summary: ansible.builtin.e is the Jinja builtin alias of escape that replaces &, <, >, ' and " with HTML-safe sequences.
questions: How do I HTML-escape a string in a template?
What does the e filter do?

answer_card.title: e filter (HTML escape)
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ value | e }}` replaces `&`, `<`, `>`, `'` and `"` with HTML-safe sequences. It's Jinja's builtin `e` (alias of `escape`).
